release_notes:
Reduce runtime settings-query overhead in post/comment/list rendering. Cache the 14 known Morphe boolean options in one volatile snapshot; home filtering reads its six flags together. Keep defaults, persistence, immediate toggles, external preference changes/clear and unknown-key fallback.

Validation: bundle built and all four patches applied to original DC Inside 5.3.20; Android 15 emulator signed installation, launch and post load checked without crash. Host regression checked 60,000 known-option/home-mask reads with zero SharedPreferences API reads, plus defaults, toggles and reset. No new whole-app CPU percentage or battery saving has been measured. Version-number-free guarded compatibility remains included.
